Adjusting Shim Selection Chart
EXHAUST

[THIS IS TABLE: A large shim selection chart with measured clearance values on the left (ranging from 0.000-0.008 to 1.028-1.040) and installed shim thickness values across the top (ranging from 2.500 to 3.300 mm). The table contains shim numbers (02-34) for different clearance and thickness combinations.]

Exhaust valve clearance (cold):
0.20 — 0.30 mm (0.008 — 0.012 in.)

Example:
A 2.800 mm shim is installed and the
valve clearance is 0.450 mm.
Replace the 2.800 mm shim with
shim No. 22 (3.000 mm).
